speaker: client
text:
I found a few items that may or may not be problems. Please tell me which are genuine issues; if any are not, that is fine, but explain why:

1\. For buttons 3 and 4 and the slide switch, CN17 / CN19 / CN20 connect the GPIO nets to GND when pressed. However, R16 / R17 / R18 are also pull-downs to GND on those same nets, so the GPIO would read LOW when pressed and LOW when released. Should those resistors instead be pull-UPS to +3V3, or should connector pin 1 receive +3V3?

speaker: client
text: Pin 28, VRTC, on the AXP2101 is currently unconnected, although the datasheet calls for a 100 nF capacitor between VRTC and GND. Was that deliberate, or was it overlooked?

speaker: client
text: Could you bring the currently unconnected AXP2101 PWROK (pin 29) and VBACKUP (pin 27) out to small test pads or vias beside the AXP2101? Exposing VBACKUP would let us later fit a backup capacitor or coin cell for RTC retention or wake-from-off, while PWROK would be available for debugging. These should be signal traces only, not power, so the change should be quick.
